# Planning Acceptance Criteria

Use this skill to make planning output testable.

Rules:
- Prefer observable behavior over implementation wishes.
- Include explicit non-goals when scope could widen.
- Tie each criterion to a validation method when practical.
- Keep criteria concise enough to fit into handoff packets.

Return criteria, non-goals, validation notes, and open assumptions.
